tool.name: scrape_instagram_profiles
tool.description: Instagram profile API without login: send up to 5 usernames, @handles or profile links per request and get followers, following, full name, bio, the real destinations of the bio links, verified and private flags, pronouns, profile picture and the linked Threads account, as JSON.

usernames.title: Instagram usernames
usernames.description: Usernames, @handles or profile links, for example natgeo, @nasa or https://www.instagram.com/nike/. A request returns 5 profiles at most.
